mutation: Eight conditions, each applied to the real runner or the real application and then reverted. F1: the readiness probe is suppressed so the server can never be observed ready. F2: the smoke is pointed at a database named legalos_production. F3: the runner declines to terminate the server it started. F4: `verifySessionToken` is made to accept a session it cannot find. F5: an expired session is admitted by the live entry path. F6: `resolveServerSession` reads `getAll(SESSION_COOKIE)[0]` so it would select a different duplicate cookie from every other path. F7: sign-in issues a session cookie although no delivery provider is configured. F8: `verifySelection` returns null, so a valid active-organisation preference stops taking effect.
performedBy: executed during obligation 4 against a running Next.js development server; every mutation reverted and the absence of residue verified. Seven of the eight turned the smoke red. F1 exits 1 on 'the development server did not become ready', with the server still terminated and the data still cleaned. F2 exits 2 from preflight before anything is launched, refused by the canonical assertTestDatabase guard rather than by a rule written here. F3 exits 1 on 'the server process terminated — alive=true', and `pnpm check:smoke` independently refuses the evidence it wrote. F4 fails four cases including 'an unknown session is refused by the route, not only by the edge'. F5 fails 'expired session refused at runtime'. F7 fails 'sign-in issues no session cookie'. F8 fails five cases including 'a cookie of the form the switch adapter emits is honoured by the next request'. TWO FINDINGS ARE RECORDED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED OVER. First, F4 in its original form — making the route accept a *missing* session — changed nothing, because the middleware answers a missing cookie itself and the route is never reached. That is the two-mechanism problem for the fourth time in this programme; a case asking a question only the route can answer (a well-formed cookie naming no session, which passes the edge shape test) was added, and F4 then bites. Second, F6 CANNOT BE CONSTRUCTED AT ALL. The mutation is semantically inert: `new RequestCookies(headers)` over a Cookie header carrying one name twice reports size 1 and `getAll(name)` returns a single value, so `getAll(name)[0]` is `get(name)`. Duplicates are collapsed into a Map before any application code can look. This was measured directly, not reasoned about, and it corrects an inference obligation 3 recorded about the same mutation.
